name: Duskwing · Gremlet #12
description:
A golden flying fox that sleeps all day and flutters out at dusk.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Duskwing in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
